title: CALL ... USING (default BY REFERENCE) — callee mutates the caller's variable in place
sourceContent:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. INCREMENT.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-COUNTER  PIC 9(4).
      *> Default for CALL ... USING is BY REFERENCE -- the called
      *> program receives a POINTER to WS-COUNTER. Any modification
      *> in the callee is visible to the caller. BY CONTENT (or BY
      *> VALUE on COMP-only fields) copies on call. Java parameter
      *> passing is always by value (of reference) -- no exact match.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           CALL "INCREMENT-COUNTER" USING WS-COUNTER.
           DISPLAY WS-COUNTER.
notes: BY REFERENCE is the default and the most common port surprise — Java passes 'value of reference' which means primitives are copied but objects are shared. A COBOL BY REFERENCE on PIC 9(4) is closer to AtomicInteger than to int.
